zh_text: 1.信誉分代表近期游戏行为，玩家的初始信誉分都是100分；[br]2.玩家的以下违规行为会扣除一定信誉分：[br]         短时间多次主动退出对局；[br]         短时间多次拒绝匹配；[br]         在对局中挂机；[br]    主动退出对局和拒绝匹配次数会统计最近24小时内的行为，还会导致禁赛惩罚；[br]    在对局中多次、严重挂机的信誉分惩罚会逐步递增，甚至会被踢出对局；[br]3.玩家的正常游戏行为可以恢复信誉分：[br]         每日登录会恢复2点信誉分；[br]         每次正常完成对局，且在对局中无违规行为，会恢复1点信誉分；[br]         每天最多恢复10点信誉分；[br]4.信誉分低于90分会受到禁赛惩罚，必须恢复到90分及以上才能解除禁赛；[br]         注意，禁赛惩罚会对所有竞技玩法的排位赛生效。

text: 1. Credit Score reflects recent gameplay behavior. All players start with 100 Credit Score.[br]2. The following violations will result in a deduction of Credit Score:[br]         Repeatedly leaving matches early in a short period;[br]         Repeatedly declining matches in a short period;[br]         Going AFK during a match;[br]    Leaving matches and declining matches are tracked over the last 24 hours and may result in matchmaking bans;[br]    Penalties for repeated or severe AFK behavior in matches will increase progressively and may lead to being kicked from the match;[br]3. Normal gameplay behavior can restore Credit Score:[br]         Logging in daily restores 2 points;[br]         Completing a match normally without any violations restores 1 point;[br]         A maximum of 10 points can be restored per day;[br]4. If your Credit Score falls below 90, you will be banned from matchmaking. You must restore it to 90 or higher to lift the ban;[br]         Note: Matchmaking bans apply to all competitive Ranked modes.
